visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a white hooded suit and a white headband with a decorative pin stands against a plain white background, performing an exaggerated comedic skit. She uses dramatic facial expressions including wide eyes and scowling while pointing towards herself. Bright studio lighting is used. (2) Close-up shots of the woman's face show her applying a white cream and a brownish liquid to her skin. Red and blue text overlays appear on the screen periodically. (3) The scene shifts to the woman sitting behind a white table with two skincare product containers (a jar and a dropper bottle). She uses hand gestures to explain concepts, with graphics of a house and steel bars appearing to illustrate her points. (4) Split-screen and picture-in-picture frames compare the woman's face 'Before' and 'After' the product usage. (5) Close-up shots of the skincare products are shown, including the texture of the cream and the liquid inside the dropper. (6) The woman continues talking directly to the camera, holding the product jars and making enthusiastic gestures until the end of the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking rapidly in Traditional Chinese. A series of sharp cartoon sound effects and comedic impacts accentuate her dramatic delivery. An upbeat, electronic-pop BGM with a strong 4/4 beat starts immediately. (2) As the tone shifts from comedic to informative, the vocal delivery remains clear and bright but becomes more narrative. Short 'ding' and 'whoosh' sounds mark the appearance of graphics and text. (3) The BGM continues as a steady, high-energy background layer. The speaker's articulation is precise, maintaining high arousal and positive valence. (4) Transitional SFX like record scratches or fast whooshes occur during rapid scene cuts between skits and product demonstrations. (5) In the final segment, the voice is authoritative and persuasive, with occasional rising intonations for emphasis, ending with a celebratory and conclusive tone over the fading music bed.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Evidence -> Benefit -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous skit about family pressure and 'dying collagen' as a hook to introduce SkinCeuticals skincare products. It transitions into a technical and informative explanation of the products' ingredients (Pro-Xylane, Vitamin C) to persuade viewers of their effectiveness in anti-aging and skin repair.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, mention of brand name SkinCeuticals, and explanation of ingredient benefits.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-energy social media advertisement that blends comedy skits with professional skincare advice to maintain viewer engagement while promoting high-end beauty products.
